_comment: Claude Code hook wiring for perfectify_guard.py. Merge into ~/.claude/settings.json or .claude/settings.json. Replace the absolute path. Restart the session: hook config is read at startup.
_comment_sandbox: Optional second layer, suggested by a reader on the launch thread and verified against Claude Code 2.1.123. autoAllowBashIfSandboxed defaults to TRUE, so sandboxed Bash is auto-approved unless you set this. Turning it off means you get the permission prompt back. Omit this block if you do not want that behaviour change.

env._comment_env: All four are optional. Unset means off.
